research only: confirmed a WordPress 'event'/'session' custom-post-type REST namespace exists (x-wp-total 1390), but no usable performance-date field was found there within this bounded proof — the /agenda/ HTML listing's own <time datetime=...> attributes are used instead. findings.total_pages_observed: at least 11 (rel="next" pagination link chain observed; only page 1 fetched for this bounded proof)
findings.stable_identifier: Each card's own first-party /event/{slug}/?selected_session={id} link embeds Casa da Música's own numeric WordPress 'session' custom-post-type id (independently corroborated against wp-json/wp/v2/session/{id}) — used as source_record_id.
findings.date_time: Each card carries a machine-readable <time datetime="YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"> attribute (local Portugal wall-clock time, no UTC offset or Z suffix) — confirmed twice per card in independent human-readable and machine forms. certainty is honestly FLOATING_LOCAL (a real, unambiguous calendar date and local time, but no confirmed UTC offset), never fabricated to UTC_INSTANT.
findings.venue_identity: Every card on /agenda/ is a session inside the one Casa da Música building; a per-card sub-location (auditorium/room, e.g. 'Sala 2') is shown but not a separate venue name. Resolved by source_id in ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs, matching the MEO Arena/Village Underground precedent.
findings.genre_text: Each card carries a source-provided descriptive line beneath the title (e.g. 'Fado e Música Tradicional Portuguesa') — retained as source-provided descriptive text, not asserted as a governed taxonomy.
